component: Notification metric definition and producer naming

quotes.text:
interaction:
    type: event
    description: >
      Main interaction button of a notification is clicked.
    bugs:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1919278
    data_reviews:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1919278#c4
    data_sensitivity:
      - interaction
    notification_emails:
      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
    expires: never
    extra_keys:
      notification_id:
        description: ID of the notification
        type: string
      active_this_session:
        description: Amount of seconds this notification was active in this session.
        type: quantity

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1031 adds the inappnotifications event definitions to mail/moz.configure and records notification_id and active_this_session extras with the same declared spelling. The accepted schema identifies quantity extras in seconds and links data_reviews to the specific #c4 comment instead of the historical incomplete #c fragment. These source references do not establish that the data review was approved; its human context is still unread. Check the exact schema and registration before adding a producer field.
title: Keep metric definitions, generated field names and build registration together
